mandatory_legal_checks: NI Act 1881 S.138 proviso (a) — the cheque must have been presented within three months of its date or its validity
NI Act 1881 S.138 proviso (b) — the demand must be made within THIRTY DAYS of receiving the bank's return memo; this is jurisdictional
NI Act 1881 S.138 proviso (c) — the drawer gets FIFTEEN DAYS from RECEIPT; the notice must not shorten it or state a calendar date computed from an assumed service date
NI Act 1881 S.138 — the demand must be for the cheque amount ALONE; adding interest or costs to the demanded figure defeats the complaint
NI Act 1881 S.142(1)(b) — the complaint must be filed within ONE MONTH of the cause of action, which arises on the SIXTEENTH day after service
NI Act 1881 S.142(2) — jurisdiction lies where the payee's bank branch is situated
NI Act 1881 S.139 — the presumption that the cheque was for a debt is rebuttable; the underlying liability must be pleaded
The return endorsement matters — 'account closed' and 'payment stopped' have been treated as within S.138, but confirm the current position for the endorsement actually used
